name: DesignCraft v0.7.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Adopt shared panel docking and preserve workspace commands by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/409
* ci: refactor workflows to use storytold/craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/489
* Place: PDF pages and SVGs keep their exact size by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/511
* Hyphenation: Portuguese text is hyphenated with hyph-utf8's Portuguese patterns by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/512
* UI: Return and Escape in the font menu stay in the menu, never reach the dialog under it by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/447
* M6: Adopt craft-print and support Windows PDF printing by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/452
* Color parsing: one scale per colour, not per component by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/510
* Place: an image placed into a frame leaves Auto-Fit off by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/528
* Assets: one asset per image, and saves leave out unused ones by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/420
* Words in capitals hyphenate like capitalized words by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/538
* IDML: part names match leniently, and missing parts are reported by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/356
* MCP: never replay a request after a lost reply by @KnottyDyes in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/514
* Parent-page items are composed for their page by index, not page name by @seanth in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/523
* Text: a character fill must name a swatch in the document by @KnottyDyes in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/403
* Object fills and strokes must name a swatch by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/520
* Duplicate, Step and Repeat and copy-moves report the copies' ids by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/521
* Release workflow: pass the Azure signing secrets by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/534

## New Contributors
* @KnottyDyes made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/514
* @seanth made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/523

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.1

name: DesignCraft v0.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Images: PSD decode passes clippy on Rust 1.98 by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/136
* Compose: don't panic when a hyphenated paragraph starts with a no-break letter by @IHAGI-c in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/115
* Show an alert when a file can't be opened or placed by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/80
* UI: text fields take Select All, Copy, Cut, Paste, Undo and Redo from the Mac menu (#30) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/111
* UI: toolbars that don't fit the window switch to two columns or scroll (#57) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/112
* Images: set SVG text in the shared fonts when the bundled ones lack it by @IHAGI-c in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/116
* Fix browser printing, startup flags, and document MIME by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/117
* Honor MCP typing, story, and page contracts by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/118
* Preserve typed values in generic command dialogs by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/120
* CLI: export options after the last export are an error; MCP and README docs match the code by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/127
* PDF/A keeps placed images; right-to-left tables and columns by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/128
* Commands: huge row and column counts can't exhaust memory by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/137
* Web: AltGr and other named keys no longer type their names (#134) by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/138
* Docs, About: the Illustrator-class sibling is VectorCraft (#59) by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/139
* UI: ruler units by right-click, Language in Properties by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/145
* Import: RTF and Tagged Text keep characters past U+FFFF by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/149
* Apply contextual escaping to HTML and EPUB exports by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/152
* Word import: keep tracked moved text (w:moveTo) by @thaynej in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/257
* Autoflow: add only the pages breaks ask for by @thaynej in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/266
* fix(engine): object.opacity accepts its documented lowercase blend modes by @kubuntugamer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/275
* Fonts: the Document Fonts folder is found whatever its case by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/287
* UI: Quick Apply opens without running an entry; rows are left-aligned by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/239
* UI: the shortcut recorder waits for the key; Interactive for PDF and Digital Publishing open their panels by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/264
* UI: the Control panel shows its second row by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/142
* PDF: a damaged PNG, GIF or WebP is skipped, not fatal by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/147
* fix(cli): --help prints usage to stdout and exits 0 by @kubuntugamer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/254
* Desktop: write log records to standard error and a rotating log file by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/122
* Distribute selected table rows evenly and keep the edit undoable by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/224
* Prevent mixed gradient color spaces from aborting PDF export by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/229
* Preserve text decoration color resets, geometry and paint order by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/230
* Rebind embedded image links when opening relocated packages (#235) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/244
* IDML: layers import and export in stacking order; font names with a format suffix by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/247
* docs: register the MCP server from an installed release by @sawizzle in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/269
* fix(ui): Make menu entries selectable across the full row by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/249
* Add PDF/X-4 validation command by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/200
* Text: text after a paragraph that spans columns flows below it by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/276
* Text: the line before a column, frame or page break is a last line by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/283
* chore: bump github actions to fix Node 20 deprecation warnings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/268
* Add Ukrainian interface translation by @dmatviichuk in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/236
* i18n: translate the whole interface into Japanese by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/272
* UI: one searchable font menu everywhere; the Contextual Task Bar can be moved by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/143
* Preserve browser import intent and document targets by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/119
* i18n: a new English string doesn't fail the Ukrainian catalog test by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/294
* Styles: Character Style Options dialog by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/144
* Swatch menus: make the whole row (chip included) clickable and show chips in the Contextual Task Bar by @vpkoskinen in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/199
* fix(ui): Add A6 sheet preset to the welcome page by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/248
* Hyphenation: Spanish text is hyphenated with Javier Bezos's patterns by @rossaai in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/222
* PDF/X-4: RGB images carry sRGB, no image interpolation, pdf:Trapped in XMP by @rossaai in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/223
* Paragraph Rules: a dialog for the selected paragraphs and a section in Paragraph Style Options by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/263
* i18n: one Tint: row per catalog by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/296
* Text frames: column rules on screen, in PDF and in IDML; Column Rules in Text Frame Options by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/274
* Text: a line with a tab wraps at the column edge by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/282
* UI: closing a document with unsaved changes asks first (#141) by @jahala in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/146
* Text: a justified line with a tab justifies the text after its last tab by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/284
* I18n italian by @emanuelebonaventura in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/218
* test(datamerge): pin facing-page record placement (#198 no longer reproduces) by @kubuntugamer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/258
* Text: a column, frame or page break ends its paragraph; odd and even page breaks by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/285
* Harden temporary files and release inputs by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/153
* Set a text selection as warichu inside the parent line by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/280
* IDML: resolve table styles and correct cell height fitting by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/288
* Keep menus and dialogs usable at larger UI scales by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/281
* PDF: reuse image conversions and index page objects (from #176) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/300
* PDF: a placed image whose file is missing is reported as missing by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/299
* Lists: numbering formats and expressions from IDML; an empty paragraph gets no bullet or number by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/298
* Desktop: pick the graphics backend before the window exists; DirectX 12 on Windows by @JeremyYao in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/297
* Text: a word longer than the line breaks at the column edge; a line that exactly fills the measure fits by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/293
* PDF export: options dialog with remembered settings by @vpkoskinen in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/196
* Text: Split Columns sets a paragraph in sub-columns within its column by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/295
* Validate engine work counts and package filenames by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/155
* Progress docs: full re-measure against InDesign 2026 21.6 (craftrules standard) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/355
* Release prep: version 0.6.0; Linux riscv64 tar.gz in releases by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/398

## New Contributors
* @jahala made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/136

* @dylanmtaylor made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/268
* @dmatviichuk made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/236
* @haranishi made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/272
* @vpkoskinen made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/199
* @rossaai made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/222
* @emanuelebonaventura made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/218

name: DesignCraft v0.4.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Text: text.select documents its offsets as UTF-8 bytes by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/37
* Text: carriage returns in typed or created text start paragraphs by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/38
* Engine: commands given ids run without a selection by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/39
* PDF: [Paper] prints as no ink in print exports by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/41
* PDF: placed PDF 1.7 files go into PDF/X-4 exports by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/40
* PDF: transparency groups blend in CMYK in print exports by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/42
* CLI: a closed stdout ends designcraft-cli quietly by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/43
* Preflight: placed PDF and SVG graphics have no resolution to check by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/44
* Fix #22: installed fonts are found by name whatever ran before by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/36
* Snap: smart guides and snapping by @CameronGilroy in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/33
* Windows on ARM64: release builds, PE header check, install test on ARM64 hardware by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/49
* Fonts: use craft-fonts as an optional build input; move the Japanese fonts out by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/51
* Add Simplified Chinese and Arabic localization with RTL support by @ShaoWenbinSaleh in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/52
* Rename PrintCraft to PdfCraft by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/95
* About: contributor and model credits compiled in (grab bag + table, self-submitted names) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/108
* IDML: import scalar InsetSpacing property values by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/105
* IDML: honor explicit cell edges at table borders by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/102
* Render: keep outside-aligned strokes out of closed interiors by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/104
* IDML: resolve nested packaged image links after relocation by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/101
* Fonts: read Microsoft Office's bundled fonts on macOS by @denizkoekden in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/97
* Transform: Rotate and Shear open their dialogs (#34) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/79
* Canvas: middle-mouse drag pans the view by @epfabian in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/53
* Guides: honor layer protection in move and delete commands by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/56
* Control: close the connection on input that isn't a request by @Luskish in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/66
* Preserve and compose Chinese and Arabic typesetting rules by @ShaoWenbinSaleh in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/75
* PDF/X-4: flag device RGB under the CMYK output intent by @EthanSuquet in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/58
* CJK: language-aware shaping and fallback, vertical metrics, document fonts, missing-glyph boxes (builds on #75) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/85
* Images: PSD composites decode by colour mode by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/82
* i18n: add Brazilian Portuguese (pt-br) UI translation by @RicSchonfelder in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/103
* PDF: placed CMYK TIFFs keep their inks by @EthanSuquet in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/55
* Complete Arabic translations, refine Chinese terminology, and cache RTL label layouts by @ShaoWenbinSaleh in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/78
* Data merge: linked source, placeholders, preview, and tiled merge by @CameronGilroy in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/76
* Release: FreeBSD, Flatpak x86_64/aarch64, AppImage zsync; README Downloads by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/132
* README Downloads: where to get it, then builds (Windows first) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/135

name: DesignCraft v0.2.0
body:
## What's Changed
* File: file.serialize returns the file's bytes (base64) — web Save wrote corrupt documents by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/3
* Layers: the active layer falls back to the top layer when it is removed by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/4
* EPUB: styles whose names slug alike keep their own CSS classes by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/5
* Licensing: standard LICENSE files, NOTICE, ArtCraft brand terms by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/6
* CI: fix new Rust 1.99 clippy lints by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/7
* UI: tool shortcuts work right after clicking the canvas (#1) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/9
* Linux: use the X11 backend under XWayland so files can be dropped (#2) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/10
* Never crash: steering rule, clippy.toml, forbid unsafe by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/8
* Never crash: importers (text, IDML, fonts, format, EPUB, images) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/15
* Never crash: doc and compose by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/16
* Never crash: render and pdf by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/17
* Never crash: engine, MCP and tools by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/18
* Never crash: geom and color by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/11
* Never crash: UI (ui-egui) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/12
* Never crash: apps (desktop, CLI, web) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/13
* Never crash: last-resort guard around every command by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/14
* Release: DesignCraft v0.2.0 by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/19

## New Contributors
* @storybored379 made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/3
* @echelon made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/6

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
